sessions.topic: declared artifact policy dependency on B-cf60

questions.question: CHK-004 mentions declared_artifact_changes passing after B-cf60, but B-cf60 is still active. Should B-4b22 wait for B-cf60 or define policy semantics now?
questions.answer: B-4b22 should define and consume the category-aware policy now, including declared_artifact_changes as a passing-with-audit category and regression tests using the classifier extension point/stub declaration data. Full story-level declaration parsing and the field BL21 lacZ artifact allowlist remain B-cf60 scope. This prevents gate policy duplication without blocking on generated artifact declaration UX.
